aervium.configuration.title: Aervium Settings
aervium.configuration.overlayVisible.too: Shows frame rate, 1% and 0.1% lows, a frame time graph, server tick time, garbage collector pauses and memory use in the top right corner. F7 turns it on and off in game.
aervium.configuration.targetFps.tooltip: The frame rate you aim for. The overlay marks frames slower than this target in yellow and frames twice as slow in red.
aervium.configuration.dynamicFps.tooltip: Lowers the frame rate while the game window is in the background or the game is paused, to save power and keep your PC cool. The world keeps ticking at full speed.
aervium.configuration.unfocusedFps.toolt: Frame rate limit while another window has the focus.
aervium.configuration.pausedFps.tooltip: Frame rate limit while the single player game is paused.
aervium.configuration.occlusionCulling.t: Skips terrain hidden behind solid blocks, like caves behind stone, and shadow casters the sun cannot see. The picture stays the same. F6 turns it on and off in game to compare.
aervium.configuration.leafCulling.toolti: Skips leaf faces buried two or more leaves deep inside a tree. Forests draw faster, but trees look slightly less dense through the gaps in the leaves, so it is off by default. Only matters with detailed (cutout) leaves; changing it rebuilds the chunks.
aervium.hardware.title: Aervium set up this PC
aervium.hardware.low: Lighter settings for this hardware: shorter view and simulation distance, leaf culling on.
aervium.hardware.medium: Lighter settings for this hardware: view and simulation distance capped.
